This is the day the Lord hath made
This is the day the Lord hath made,
He calls the hours his own;
Let heaven rejoice, let earth be glad,
Watts made this hymn from Psalm 118:24–26, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

24This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it. 25O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper! 26Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you. PSALM 118:24–26 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 118
This is the day the Lord hath made, He calls the hours his own; Let heaven rejoice, let earth be glad, And praise surround the throne. STANZA I
